name: content-ppt-pipeline
description: A content-first PowerPoint workflow for research, courses, engineering reports, technical briefings, and other evidence-heavy decks.

interface.shortDescription: Content-first workflow for evidence-heavy PowerPoint decks.
interface.longDescription: Research sources, close evidence and narrative gaps, plan slide reuse or regeneration, normalize reproducible data figures, build slide production specs, review generated pages, create editable PowerPoint files, and run whole-deck QA.
defaultPrompt: Use Content PPT Pipeline to turn my material into a content-heavy presentation.
Use Content PPT Pipeline to review and continue this technical PowerPoint project.
